# latentmixtures

A tidy R interface to the Julia package
[LatentMixtures.jl](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/LatentMixtures.jl):
latent class analysis (LCA), latent profile analysis (LPA), latent
transition analysis (LTA), multigroup models with full, partial or no
measurement invariance, two-level (multilevel) latent class and profile
models with cluster-level latent classes, and latent class growth /
growth mixture models (including parallel processes). It supports FIML
for missing data, sampling weights, one-step covariates, three-step
auxiliary models (R3STEP, BCH, DCAT), robust (MLR) standard errors, and
the VLMR/LMR and bootstrap likelihood-ratio tests. Random starts run on
several threads. Results agree with Mplus on the validation cases in
`tests/`.

You write R: data frames, pipes and tidyselect column choice. The
estimation runs in one persistent Julia process.

## Installation

1.  **Julia** (\>= 1.12), for example with
    [juliaup](https://github.com/JuliaLang/juliaup):

    ``` sh
    curl -fsSL https://install.julialang.org | sh
    ```

    JuliaConnectoR must be able to find `julia`. If it is not on the
    `PATH`, set `JULIA_BINDIR` (e.g. in `~/.Renviron`:
    `JULIA_BINDIR=~/.juliaup/bin`).

2.  **R packages**:

    \
    [`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(`[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(``"JuliaConnectoR"``, ``"rlang"``, ``"tidyselect"``, ``"remotes"``)``)`\
    `# the repository is private: set a GitHub token first, e.g. Sys.setenv(GITHUB_PAT = "...")`\
    `remotes``::`[`install_github`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/reference/install_github.html)`(``"williamlorder/latentmixtures"``)`\
    `# or from a local checkout`\
    [`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"path/to/latentmixtures"``, repos ``=`` ``NULL``, type ``=`` ``"source"``)`

3.  **Julia packages**: install LatentMixtures.jl into the default Julia
    environment, from GitHub (default) or from a local copy (development
    mode):

    \
    `latentmixtures``::`[`install_julia_packages`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/install_julia_packages.md)`(``)``      ``# Pkg.add(url = "https://github.com/williamlorder/LatentMixtures.jl")`\
    `# or: install_julia_packages(path = "path/to/LatentMixtures.jl")`

    The repositories are private: you need read access, and Git must be
    able to authenticate to github.com (for example `gh auth login`
    followed by `gh auth setup-git`, or a personal access token in your
    Git credential helper).

Documentation:
<https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/>.

## Quick start

The package ships five simulated datasets with known generating models
([`?aces`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/aces.md),
[`?wellbeing`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/wellbeing.md),
[`?wellbeing_panel`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/wellbeing_panel.md),
[`?depression`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/depression.md),
[`?substance`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/substance.md));
every example below runs as is.

\
[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(``latentmixtures``)`\
[`lm_available`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_available.md)`(``)``               ``# TRUE once Julia and LatentMixtures.jl are installed`\
[`lm_start`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_start.md)`(``threads ``=`` ``4``)``        ``# optional: starts Julia once; fitting functions auto-start it`\
\
`# LCA: eight adverse childhood experiences (ace_*) of 1,500 adults. Which patterns of`\
`# childhood adversity are there? (generated with four classes)`\
[`data`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html)`(``aces``)`\
`m4`` ``<-`` ``aces`` ``|>`` `[`lca`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lca.md)`(``starts_with``(``"ace_"``)``, K ``=`` ``4``)`\
[`convergence`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/convergence.md)`(``m4``)``              ``# check that the best LL is replicated and EM reached the maximum`\
`m4``                           ``# header, fit, class sizes, item-response probabilities`\
[`summary`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/summary.html)`(``m4``)``                  ``# every parameter with robust standard errors`\
[`head`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/head.html)`(`[`classify`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/classify.md)`(``m4``)``)``           ``# posterior probabilities and modal class per row`\
\
`# covariates, known groups, weights: also columns of the data`\
[`lca`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lca.md)`(``aces``, ``starts_with``(``"ace_"``)``, K ``=`` ``4``, covariates ``=`` `[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(``female``, ``low_parent_edu``)``, weights ``=`` ``weight``)`\
[`lca`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lca.md)`(``aces``, ``starts_with``(``"ace_"``)``, K ``=`` ``4``, group ``=`` ``female``, invariance ``=`` ``"ace_sex_abuse"``)`\
\
`# LPA: sleep, activity, diet, stress, loneliness and life satisfaction`\
[`data`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html)`(``wellbeing``)`\
[`lpa`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lpa.md)`(``wellbeing``, ``sleep``:``lifesat``, K ``=`` ``4``, variances ``=`` ``"varying"``)`\
`# mixed indicator types: binary ACE items with an overdispersed symptom count (Mplus COUNT)`\
[`mixture`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/mixture.md)`(``aces``, K ``=`` ``4``, categorical ``=`` ``starts_with``(``"ace_"``)``, negbin ``=`` ``depress``)`\
`# LTA: alcohol, binge drinking, cigarettes and cannabis in grades 8, 10 and 12`\
[`data`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html)`(``substance``)`\
`t3`` ``<-`` `[`lta`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lta.md)`(``substance``, waves ``=`` `[`list`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/list.html)`(``alc_1``:``mj_1``, ``alc_2``:``mj_2``, ``alc_3``:``mj_3``)``, K ``=`` ``3``)`\
[`transitions`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/transitions.md)`(``t3``)`\
`# growth mixtures: depressive (dep1-dep5) and anxiety (anx1-anx5) symptoms, ages 12-16`\
[`data`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html)`(``depression``)`\
`g`` ``<-`` `[`growth`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/growth.md)`(``depression``, ``dep1``:``dep5``, K ``=`` ``4``, model ``=`` ``"gmm"``, degree ``=`` ``2``)`\
[`growth`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/growth.md)`(``depression``, processes ``=`` `[`list`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/list.html)`(``dep1``:``dep5``, ``anx1``:``anx5``)``, K ``=`` ``4``, model ``=`` ``"gmm"``)`\
`# two-level LCA: students in schools, 3 student classes and 2 latent school types`\
[`data`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/data.html)`(``schools``)`\
`ml`` ``<-`` `[`lca`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lca.md)`(``schools``, ``starts_with``(``"b_"``)``, K ``=`` ``3``, level2 ``=`` ``school``, KB ``=`` ``2``)`\
[`conditionalprobs`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/conditionalprobs.md)`(``ml``)``         ``# P(student class | school type)`\
\
`# three-step auxiliary models: model, data, columns`\
[`r3step`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/r3step.md)`(``m4``, ``aces``, `[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(``female``, ``age``, ``low_parent_edu``)``, ref ``=`` ``1``)``   ``# who is in which class?`\
[`bch`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/bch.md)`(``m4``, ``aces``, ``depress``)``       ``# depressive symptoms by class (generated means 4 to 13)`\
[`dcat`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/dcat.md)`(``m4``, ``aces``, ``srh``, ref ``=`` ``1``)`` ``# self-rated health by class`\
\
`# class enumeration tests: 4 against 3 classes`\
[`lmr`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lmr.md)`(``m4``)``; `[`blrt`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/blrt.md)`(``m4``, reps ``=`` ``100``)`\
\
`# nested models with the same K (e.g. measurement invariance across sex): naive and`\
`# Satorra-Bentler scaled (MLR) difference tests, as in Mplus`\
`full`` ``<-`` `[`lca`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lca.md)`(``aces``, ``starts_with``(``"ace_"``)``, K ``=`` ``4``, group ``=`` ``female``)`\
`part`` ``<-`` `[`lca`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lca.md)`(``aces``, ``starts_with``(``"ace_"``)``, K ``=`` ``4``, group ``=`` ``female``, invariance ``=`` ``"ace_sex_abuse"``)`\
`none`` ``<-`` `[`lca`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lca.md)`(``aces``, ``starts_with``(``"ace_"``)``, K ``=`` ``4``, group ``=`` ``female``, invariance ``=`` ``"none"``)`\
[`scaling_factor`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/scaling_factor.md)`(``full``)`\
[`compare_models`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/compare_models.md)`(``full``, ``part``)``   ``# sexual abuse is reported differently by women and men`\
[`compare_models`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/compare_models.md)`(`[`list`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/list.html)`(``full ``=`` ``full``, partial ``=`` ``part``, none ``=`` ``none``)``)``   ``# each vs. the previous`\
\
[`lm_end`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_start.md)`(``)``                     ``# shut Julia down (lm_start() starts a fresh one)`

Raw survey or Mplus files often code missing values as `-999`; convert
them before fitting (`dat[dat == -999] <- NA`).

The older positional form (`lca(items_df, 3)`,
`r3step(m, covariates_df)`, `bch(m, y_vector)`) still works.

## Tables

[`lm_table()`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)
formats results for papers in four formats: `"text"` (console),
`"markdown"` (GitHub), `"latex"` (booktabs) and `"html"`. It returns the
table, and writes it to a file if you give `file`. In R Markdown and
Quarto the table is inserted as it is.

\
`fits`` ``<-`` `[`lapply`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/lapply.html)`(``1``:``5``, ``function``(``k``)`` `[`lca`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lca.md)`(``aces``, ``starts_with``(``"ace_"``)``, K ``=`` ``k``)``)`\
[`names`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/names.html)`(``fits``)`` ``<-`` `[`paste0`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/paste.html)`(``1``:``5``, ``"-class"``)`\
\
`# class enumeration: K, free parameters, LL, AIC, BIC, saBIC, entropy, smallest class,`\
`# plus LMR / BLRT p-values if you pass them (the lowest information criteria are in bold)`\
[`lm_table`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)`(``fits``, lmr  ``=`` `[`lapply`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/lapply.html)`(``fits``, ``function``(``m``)`` ``if`` ``(``m``$``info``$``fit``$``K`` ``>`` ``1``)`` `[`lmr`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lmr.md)`(``m``)``)``,`\
`               blrt ``=`` `[`lapply`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/lapply.html)`(``fits``, ``function``(``m``)`` ``if`` ``(``m``$``info``$``fit``$``K`` ``>`` ``1``)`` `[`blrt`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/blrt.md)`(``m``)``)``,`\
`         format ``=`` ``"markdown"``)`\
[`lm_table`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)`(``fits``[[``3``]``]``, ``fits``[[``4``]``]``, format ``=`` ``"latex"``, file ``=`` ``"fit.tex"``, label ``=`` ``"tab:fit"``)`\
\
`# parameters: classes side by side ("est (SE)", stars on testable parameters),`\
`# or one row per parameter; confidence intervals instead of SEs`\
[`lm_table`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)`(``fits``[[``4``]``]``, what ``=`` ``"parameters"``, format ``=`` ``"latex"``, file ``=`` ``"lca4.tex"``)`\
[`lm_table`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)`(``fits``[[``4``]``]``, what ``=`` ``"parameters"``, layout ``=`` ``"long"``, ci ``=`` ``TRUE``, format ``=`` ``"html"``)`\
[`lm_table`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)`(``fits``[[``4``]``]``, what ``=`` ``"classes"``)``      ``# class sizes, average posterior probabilities`\
\
`# auxiliary models`\
[`lm_table`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)`(`[`r3step`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/r3step.md)`(``fits``[[``4``]``]``, ``aces``, `[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(``age``, ``female``)``)``, format ``=`` ``"markdown"``)`\
[`lm_table`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)`(`[`bch`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/bch.md)`(``fits``[[``4``]``]``, ``aces``, ``depress``)``, `[`bch`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/bch.md)`(``fits``[[``4``]``]``, ``aces``, ``smoker``)``, pairwise ``=`` ``TRUE``)`\
[`lm_table`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)`(`[`dcat`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/dcat.md)`(``fits``[[``4``]``]``, ``aces``, ``srh``)``, format ``=`` ``"html"``, file ``=`` ``"srh.html"``)`\
[`lm_table`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)`(`[`compare_models`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/compare_models.md)`(``full``, ``part``)``, format ``=`` ``"latex"``)`

Options: `digits`, `title`, `notes`, `stars = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001)` (or
`FALSE`), `se`, `ci`, `level`, `layout`, `kinds`, `labels`.

### Extending `lm_table()`

[`lm_table()`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_table.md)
is an S3 generic. A package with its own result class builds an `lm_tab`
(formatted cells, optional panel groups, title, notes) and renders it
with
[`lm_render()`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_tab.md),
which takes care of the four formats:

\
`#' @exportS3Method latentmixtures::lm_table`\
`lm_table.my_result`` ``<-`` ``function``(``x``, ``...``, ``format`` ``=`` `[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(``"text"``, ``"markdown"``, ``"latex"``, ``"html"``)``,`\
`                               ``digits`` ``=`` ``3``, ``file`` ``=`` ``NULL``, ``title`` ``=`` ``NULL``, ``notes`` ``=`` ``NULL``, ``label`` ``=`` ``NULL``)`` ``{`\
`  ``body`` ``<-`` `[`data.frame`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/data.frame.html)`(``Class ``=`` `[`paste`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/paste.html)`(``"Class"``, `[`seq_along`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/seq.html)`(``x``$``est``)``)``,`\
`                     Effect ``=`` `[`paste0`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/paste.html)`(`[`lm_format_num`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_format_num.md)`(``x``$``est``, ``digits``)``, `[`lm_stars`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_format_num.md)`(``x``$``p``)``)``,`\
`                     SE ``=`` `[`lm_format_num`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_format_num.md)`(``x``$``se``, ``digits``)``, p ``=`` `[`lm_format_p`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_format_num.md)`(``x``$``p``)``)`\
`  ``tab`` ``<-`` `[`lm_tab`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_tab.md)`(``body``, title ``=`` ``title`` `[`%||%`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Control.html)` ``"My estimates"``, notes ``=`` ``notes``)`\
`  `[`lm_render`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_tab.md)`(``tab``, `[`match.arg`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/match.arg.html)`(``format``)``, file ``=`` ``file``, label ``=`` ``label``)`\
`}`

## Plots

Every model and auxiliary result has an
[`autoplot()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)
method (ggplot2), and
[`plot()`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html) draws the same
figure. The functions return ggplot objects, so titles, scales and
themes can be changed with `+`. The default theme
([`lm_theme()`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_theme.md))
and the colour-blind-safe Okabe-Ito palette
([`lm_palette()`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_theme.md))
are exported for your own figures.

\
`m`` ``<-`` `[`lca`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lca.md)`(``aces``, ``starts_with``(``"ace_"``)``, K ``=`` ``4``)`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``m``, error ``=`` ``"ci"``)``            ``# item-response profiles with 95% CIs`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``m``, type ``=`` ``"bars"``)``           ``# stacked category probabilities per class`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``m``, type ``=`` ``"classification"``)`` ``# average posterior probabilities by modal class`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``m``, type ``=`` ``"posterior"``)``      ``# histograms of the assigned-class posteriors`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``m``, type ``=`` ``"sizes"``)``          ``# estimated class proportions and modal counts`\
\
`# class enumeration: information criteria and entropy against K, LMR / BLRT p-values`\
[`lm_fitplot`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_fitplot.md)`(``fits``, lmr ``=`` `[`lapply`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/lapply.html)`(``fits``, ``function``(``m``)`` ``if`` ``(``m``$``info``$``fit``$``K`` ``>`` ``1``)`` `[`lmr`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lmr.md)`(``m``)``)``)`

![LCA item-response profiles](reference/figures/README-lca-profile.png)

LCA item-response profiles

![Class enumeration](reference/figures/README-enumeration.png)

Class enumeration

\
`p`` ``<-`` `[`lpa`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lpa.md)`(``wellbeing``, ``sleep``:``lifesat``, K ``=`` ``4``, variances ``=`` ``"varying"``)`\
`p_full`` ``<-`` `[`lpa`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lpa.md)`(``wellbeing``, ``sleep``:``lifesat``, K ``=`` ``4``, variances ``=`` ``"varying"``, covariances ``=`` ``"varying"``)`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``p``, standardize ``=`` ``TRUE``)``      ``# profile means ± 95% CI, in overall-SD units`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``p``, error ``=`` ``"sd"``)``            ``# means ± within-profile SD`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``p_full``, type ``=`` ``"correlation"``)``   ``# within-profile correlations (covariances != "zero")`

![LPA profiles](reference/figures/README-lpa-profile.png)

LPA profiles

\
`t`` ``<-`` `[`lta`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lta.md)`(``substance``, waves ``=`` `[`list`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/list.html)`(``alc_1``:``mj_1``, ``alc_2``:``mj_2``, ``alc_3``:``mj_3``)``, K ``=`` ``3``)`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``t``)``                          ``# LTA transition matrices, one panel per transition`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``t``, type ``=`` ``"prevalence"``)``     ``# class proportions over the waves (geom = "area")`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``t``, type ``=`` ``"profile"``)``        ``# item profiles at every wave (non-invariance)`

![LTA transitions](reference/figures/README-lta-transitions.png)

LTA transitions

\
`# growth mixtures: estimated class trajectories, observed posterior-weighted class`\
`# means and a sample of individual trajectories (one panel per process)`\
`g`` ``<-`` `[`growth`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/growth.md)`(``depression``, ``dep1``:``dep5``, K ``=`` ``4``, model ``=`` ``"gmm"``, degree ``=`` ``2``)`\
[`autoplot`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/autoplot.html)`(``g``, data ``=`` ``depression``, spaghetti ``=`` ``60``)`

![Growth mixture trajectories](reference/figures/README-growth.png)

Growth mixture trajectories

Other figures: multigroup models (one panel per group),
`autoplot(m, type = "regression")` for one-step covariates and
`autoplot(r3step(...))` (odds-ratio forest plots), `autoplot(bch(...))`
/ `autoplot(dcat(...))` (class means / probabilities with CIs),
`autoplot(blrt(...))` (bootstrap distribution of the LR statistic) and
`autoplot(compare_models(m1, m2, m3))` (dot plot of the fit indices).
See
[`?autoplot.latentmix`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/autoplot.latentmix.md)
and the vignettes.

## Julia session

- `lm_start(threads = "auto")` starts one Julia process, sets
  `JULIA_NUM_THREADS` and loads LatentMixtures.jl once. Later calls
  reuse it. Fitting functions start it automatically, using
  `JULIA_NUM_THREADS` if it is set and `"auto"` otherwise.
- [`lm_status()`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_start.md)
  reports whether Julia is running and how many threads it has.
- [`lm_end()`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_start.md)
  stops the process. Models fitted before still print (their fit
  statistics are kept in R), but anything that needs Julia asks you to
  refit them.
- You cannot change the number of threads of a running process. To
  change it, run
  [`lm_end(); lm_start(threads = n)`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_start.md).
- [`lm_session_id()`](https://williamlorder.github.io/software/latentmixtures/reference/lm_session_id.md)
  increases with each new Julia process. Packages that load their own
  Julia code can check it to know when to reload.
